summary.text: Ross Thomas is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and small business owner from Columbus, he chairs the Bartholomew County Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Ross Thomas was born in Columbus, Indiana, and graduated from Jennings County High School.
He earned a degree in political economy from Tulane University in 1992 and a law degree from Indiana University School of Law, Indianapolis, in 1994.
He runs his own law practice and is affiliated with the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the American Bar Association and the Indiana Bar Association.
Thomas ran for Indiana House District 59 in 2022 and 2024, losing to incumbent Ryan Lauer both times.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he serves on the Youth Baseball Board for Columbus Parks and Recreation and coaches baseball.
He said his campaign focuses on tax policy that helps working people and on improving Indiana's rankings in areas such as pollution, public health funding and teacher pay.
